summary: Iter-1 cold codegen for chemical_detector: 17 Java files (two controllers, sealed event hierarchies, sensors, vehicle, clock, constants, enums, GasSensor record, @RoboChartType). All 88 requirement ids traced in result_codegen.json.

issues.title: No Final states; terminal transitions rerouted to live modes
issues.detail: CD-GA-Beh6/CD-MV-Beh9 specify final state j1. CLAUDE.md forbids a Final state on the theory-generated controller (Isabelle deadlock_free closer hangs). GasAnalysis gains a live Done mode absorbing gas; Movement's Found self-loops on stop. stop/flag still emitted on entry.

issues.title: Odometer modelled as sensor read, not input event
issues.detail: Spec's 'odometer ? d0' mid-entry reception encoded as d0 = sensors.odometer() (zero-arg sensor method -> Sensors interface var).

issues.title: CD-OP1..4 are Vehicle methods, not compute() operation classes
issues.detail: Spec marks them Vehicle-provided. M2M models move (2-arg) as operation Call; randomWalk/shortRandomWalk/changeDirection (0/1-arg) as output-event communications.

issues.title: Chem literals {CH4, CO2}; target injected via constructor; presence-based analysis
issues.detail: Chem is opaque in spec. analysis returns gasD iff any reading's chemical equals the target, at any intensity.

issues.title: Intensity encoded as double/real; empty-reading defaults
issues.detail: goreq is the ordering predicate; intensity() returns 0.0 and location() returns Front for empty readings.

issues.title: All constants = 1
issues.detail: THR, LV, EVADE_TIME, STUCK_PERIOD, STUCK_DIST, OUT_PERIOD all 1/1.0 to fit FDR4 type ranges {0..1}.

issues.title: Waiting during-action randomWalk() encoded as top-of-mode statement (extracts as entry)
issues.detail: RoboChart 'during' is not producible by the pipeline; entry is the closest extractable encoding.

issues.title: angle() index map 0-based: 0=Front, 1=Left, 2=Right, else Back
issues.detail: Spec leaves the (1-based) index->direction map abstract.

issues.title: Total guard covers on autonomous-only modes; no self-loops
issues.detail: Analysis (two-valued sts), GasDetected (goreq vs !goreq), AvoidingAgain (stuck disjunction vs negation) have jointly-exhaustive guards per CLAUDE.md. M2M deadlock-lint advisories on these states are expected and ignorable.
